items.title: How much deep-work time survives, as interruptions get more frequent
items.description: A simplified model of L2's frequency-vs-length point: out of an 8-hour (480-minute) day, only the time after each interruption's refocus window counts as true full-depth work. Drag the time between interruptions and see how little survives once it drops below the refocus time.

params.name: residuePerInterruption
params.label: Minutes to refocus after each interruption

items.compute: const fraction = Math.max(0, params.interruptionInterval - params.residuePerInterruption) / params.interruptionInterval; return { deepWorkMinutes: Math.round(fraction * 480) };

outputs.label: True deep-work minutes out of an 8-hour day
